answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 50 epochs. Receipts are issued in vertex, burned on slash in orchard, and listed in ember. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Scaling to 349 identities multiplies that fee by 491 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
